get.summary: Read the tenant, account and token behind the bearer

put.summary: Bind an SCM owner to the tenant with a proof
put.description: Requires the installations:write scope. The body carries a CI proof or an App attestation, and README.md, section Identity, states the rules. A tenant that holds this installation answers 200 even when the proof has expired, and only a valid newer proof moves proven_at. A refused proof changes nothing. The platform reads who holds the owner only after the proof passes, so INSTALLATION_BOUND_ELSEWHERE reaches only a caller with a valid proof. A binding never moves rows between tenants.

appAttestation.summary: An attestation signed by Costroid's hosted service

200.description: The installation is bound to this tenant.

400.description: INSTALLATION_PROOF_MISSING: the body holds no proof, or the proof is not a compact JWS.

403.description: AUTH_TOKEN_SCOPE: the token lacks the scope this operation names. The other codes refuse the proof. INSTALLATION_PROOF_ISSUER_UNTRUSTED: its issuer is not a trusted one. INSTALLATION_PROOF_SIGNATURE_INVALID: its algorithm is not RS256, its key id is unknown or its signature fails. INSTALLATION_PROOF_AUDIENCE_MISMATCH: its audience is not this tenant's. INSTALLATION_PROOF_EXPIRED: it is past exp, more than 600 seconds past iat, or issued before the installation's last change. INSTALLATION_PROOF_CLAIMS_INVALID: a required stable id is absent or not a number. INSTALLATION_PROOF_UNPROTECTED_RUN: the run could start without passing the owner's protected branch. INSTALLATION_PROOF_SUBJECT_MISMATCH: it proves another installation than the path names.

INSTALLATION_PROOF_ISSUER_UNTRUSTED.summary: A self-hosted service or a self-managed SCM signed it

INSTALLATION_PROOF_CLAIMS_INVALID.summary: The proof holds names and no stable id

INSTALLATION_PROOF_UNPROTECTED_RUN.summary: A run outside the protected branch

409.description: INSTALLATION_BOUND_ELSEWHERE: the proof is valid and another tenant holds this owner under a rule the proof does not beat.

503.description: INSTALLATION_PROOF_KEYS_UNAVAILABLE: the issuer's key set cannot be read. Nothing was judged, and the same proof can be retried inside its window.

INSTALLATION_PROOF_KEYS_UNAVAILABLE.summary: The key set cannot be read

delete.description: Requires the installations:write scope. The binding ends as revoked and needs no proof, because a tenant can always give up what it holds. Costroid's hosted service calls this when GitHub reports the App uninstalled or suspended. The tenant keeps its rows. A repeat answers 200 and changes nothing.

409.description: INSTALLATION_NOT_BOUND: this tenant never held this installation.

INSTALLATION_NOT_BOUND.summary: This tenant never held the installation

get.description: Any scope. The answer never holds the secret.

post.description: Any scope. The answer holds the new secret once. The old token keeps working until previous_token_expires_at.

put.description: Requires the rows:write scope. The body is a FOCUS row CSV as focus-row/v0.5 defines it, with the tag set of tags/v0.4. The tenant comes from the token and never from the body. A new batch_id adds rows. The same batch_id with different bytes replaces every row of the earlier bytes, in every month they named, once the new bytes have ingested. The same batch_id with the same bytes answers 200 and changes nothing. A batch ingests whole or fails whole. Every Tags key outside costroid/ is dropped before storage and counted in dropped_tag_keys. A refusal stores nothing. README.md, sections The export endpoint and What a row proves, states the rules.

schema.description: UTF-8 CSV with one header row, as focus-row/v0.5 defines it. Tags is a JSON object in one cell.

exportBody.summary: Eleven rows of one GitHub Actions run, token_verified

200.description: These bytes are already held under this batch_id.

202.description: The batch is accepted for ingest. Read its verdict from GET /exports/{batch_id}.

400.description: A header is missing or malformed.

402.description: PLAN_WRITES_REFUSED: the tenant's plan does not allow writes at present. Nothing was stored. A sender keeps the rows, warns, and never fails a check on this answer.

403.description: AUTH_TOKEN_SCOPE: the token lacks the rows:write scope. RUN_TOKEN_INVALID: Costroid-Run-Token is present and is not a GitHub Actions ID token for this tenant's rows audience inside its window, or its signature fails. RUN_TOKEN_OWNER_MISMATCH: the run token's repository_owner_id is not the owner of the installation in Costroid-Installation-Id.

RUN_TOKEN_OWNER_MISMATCH.summary: The run belongs to another owner

409.description: INSTALLATION_NOT_BOUND: this tenant holds no active binding of the installation, including one that was revoked or displaced. EXPORT_BATCH_BUSY: this batch_id has an ingest in flight, and these bytes differ from it. EXPORT_BATCH_RUN_BOUND: this batch's active rows hold token_verified rows, and the request carries no run token, or one of another run or repository.

INSTALLATION_NOT_BOUND.summary: The installation is not bound to this tenant

EXPORT_BATCH_BUSY.summary: Other bytes of this batch are ingesting

EXPORT_BATCH_RUN_BOUND.summary: This batch's rows are bound to another run

422.description: HASH_MISMATCH: the body does not hash to Costroid-Content-SHA256.

HASH_MISMATCH.summary: The body is not the bytes the header names

get.description: Requires the rows:write scope. A failed batch carries its code in failure. A client treats a code it does not know as a failed batch.

droppedTagKeys.summary: Ingested, two free-form tag entries dropped

failed.summary: Failed on a value the store cannot hold

RUN_TOKEN_MISSING.summary: A token_verified row arrived without a run token

ROW_IDENTITY_MISMATCH.summary: A row names another run than the run token

ROW_COST_INCONSISTENT.summary: A row's cost is not its unit price times its quantity

ROW_PROFILE_STRICT.summary: A row is in the strict profile

404.description: EXPORT_BATCH_NOT_FOUND: this tenant holds no such batch.

put.summary: Send the fact that one pull request merged
put.description: Requires the merges:write scope. The body states that this pull request of this repository merged at this instant as this commit, and holds no other key. The tenant comes from the token and never from the body. A run token whose sha is merge_commit_sha and whose ref_type is branch stores the fact as token_verified; any other verified run token, or none, stores it as unverified. A pull request holds one fact: a token_verified document replaces an unverified one under the same merge_id, whether or not the two differ; any other request that repeats the held document answers 200 and changes nothing; and every other second document answers 409 MERGE_FACT_CONFLICT. The platform compares parsed values, never bytes. A refusal stores nothing. README.md, section The merge fact, states the rules.

merge.summary: Pull request 1482 merged as one commit

200.description: This document is already held under this merge_id. Nothing changed. The answer is the stored fact, with its run_identity.

201.description: The fact is stored: a new fact, or a token_verified fact in place of an unverified one. The answer carries its run_identity.

tokenVerified.summary: Sent by a push run whose sha is the merge commit

400.description: A header is missing or malformed.

402.description: PLAN_WRITES_REFUSED: the tenant's plan does not allow writes at present. Nothing was stored. A sender keeps its document, warns, and never fails a check on this answer.

403.description: AUTH_TOKEN_SCOPE: the token lacks the merges:write scope. RUN_TOKEN_INVALID: Costroid-Run-Token is present and is not a GitHub Actions ID token for this tenant's rows audience inside its window, or its signature fails. RUN_TOKEN_OWNER_MISMATCH: the run token's repository_owner_id is not the owner of the installation in Costroid-Installation-Id.

AUTH_TOKEN_SCOPE.summary: The token cannot write merge facts

RUN_TOKEN_OWNER_MISMATCH.summary: The run belongs to another owner

409.description: INSTALLATION_NOT_BOUND: this tenant holds no active binding of the installation, including one that was revoked or displaced. MERGE_FACT_CONFLICT: this merge_id holds a different document, and the request is not a token_verified document over an unverified one; or another merge_id holds a fact for this repo and pull_request.

INSTALLATION_NOT_BOUND.summary: The installation is not bound to this tenant

MERGE_FACT_CONFLICT.summary: The pull request already holds another fact

422.description: MERGE_FACT_INVALID: a key is missing, unknown or of the wrong form. MERGE_FACT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: the run token verifies, and repo is not github.com/ followed by the token's repository.

MERGE_FACT_INVALID.summary: The body holds a key this version does not read

MERGE_FACT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH.summary: The run token names another repository

get.description: Requires the merges:write scope. The answer is the stored document with its run_identity.

mergeQueue.summary: A fact of a merge queue's group whose commit is not the push's tip

404.description: MERGE_FACT_NOT_FOUND: this tenant holds no such merge_id.

put.description: Requires the reconciliations:write scope. The body is newline-delimited JSON, one ReconciliationRow per line. A row's key is source, credential and day. A row replaces the stored row of its key, except that a final row is never replaced by one that is not final, and a row whose data_refreshed_at is earlier than the stored row's is ignored. The whole body is validated before the first write, and one bad line refuses it with that line's number. A body is stored whole or not at all, for a storage failure as for a bad line. On a 5xx the sender sends the same body again. The platform shows each row as the sender's statement, never as its own measurement. README.md, section The reconciliation result, states the rules.

schema.description: UTF-8, one ReconciliationRow per line, each line ended by a line feed. At most max_reconciliation_lines lines, max_reconciliation_bytes bytes and max_reconciliation_line_bytes bytes a line, as GET /quotas states them.

200.description: The body is stored. The answer counts its rows by what each did.

stored.summary: Six rows stored, one unchanged and one ignored

400.description: A header is missing or malformed, including a Costroid-Run-Token sent without Costroid-Installation-Id.

402.description: PLAN_WRITES_REFUSED: the tenant's plan does not allow writes at present. Nothing was stored. A sender keeps the rows, warns, and never fails a check on this answer.

403.description: AUTH_TOKEN_SCOPE: the token lacks the reconciliations:write scope. RUN_TOKEN_INVALID: Costroid-Run-Token is present and is not a GitHub Actions ID token for this tenant's rows audience inside its window, or its signature fails. RUN_TOKEN_OWNER_MISMATCH: the run token's repository_owner_id is not the owner of the installation in Costroid-Installation-Id.

RUN_TOKEN_OWNER_MISMATCH.summary: The run belongs to another owner

409.description: INSTALLATION_NOT_BOUND: Costroid-Installation-Id names an installation this tenant holds no active binding of, including one that was revoked or displaced.

INSTALLATION_NOT_BOUND.summary: The installation is not bound to this tenant

413.description: RECONCILIATION_TOO_LARGE: the body is past max_reconciliation_bytes or max_reconciliation_lines, or a line is past max_reconciliation_line_bytes. Nothing was stored.

RECONCILIATION_TOO_LARGE.summary: The body holds more lines than the limit

422.description: RECONCILIATION_INVALID: a line is not a ReconciliationRow of this version, or repeats the key of an earlier line. The answer names the first such line in error.line. Nothing was stored.

RECONCILIATION_INVALID.summary: Line 3 states an amount as a number

get.summary: Read the stored rows of one credential over a range of days
get.description: Requires the reconciliations:write scope. The answer holds the stored row of each day from from to to, both included, that has one, in order of day, each with who sent it and when. A day with no stored row is absent. The range spans at most max_reconciliation_range_days days, as GET /quotas states it.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last UTC day, included. Not before from.

400.description: A query parameter is missing or malformed, to is before from, or the range spans more than max_reconciliation_range_days days.

integrationToken.description: An integration token. See README.md, section Tokens.

InstallationHeader.name: Costroid-Installation-Id
InstallationHeader.description: The installation these rows came through, held active by this tenant.

ContentSha256.name: Costroid-Content-SHA256
ContentSha256.description: The SHA-256 of the body in lower-case hexadecimal.

FocusVersion.name: Costroid-Focus-Version
FocusVersion.description: The FOCUS version the rows declare.

RunTokenHeader.name: Costroid-Run-Token
RunTokenHeader.description: The sending job's own GitHub Actions ID token, minted with this tenant's rows audience. It names the run that sent the batch. A batch that holds a token_verified row needs it. The platform never stores or logs it. README.md, section The run token, states the rules.

MergeInstallationHeader.name: Costroid-Installation-Id
MergeInstallationHeader.description: The installation the fact came through, held active by this tenant. A run token's owner is checked against it.

MergeRunTokenHeader.name: Costroid-Run-Token
MergeRunTokenHeader.description: The sending job's own GitHub Actions ID token, minted with this tenant's rows audience, as on an export. The platform also reads its sha, ref and ref_type. Without it the fact is stored as unverified. The platform never stores or logs it. README.md, section The merge fact, states the rules.

ReconciliationInstallationHeader.name: Costroid-Installation-Id
ReconciliationInstallationHeader.description: The installation the body came through, held active by this tenant. Required with Costroid-Run-Token, whose owner is checked against it.

ReconciliationRunTokenHeader.name: Costroid-Run-Token
ReconciliationRunTokenHeader.description: The sending job's own GitHub Actions ID token, minted with this tenant's rows audience, as on an export. It proves only which run sent the body. The platform never stores or logs it.

QuotaState.description: The most urgent state across the tenant's quotas after this request.

NoStore.description: The answer holds a secret and is never cached.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds until the refused request can succeed.

Unauthorized.description: AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID: the token is absent, unknown, expired or revoked. The four cases answer alike.

Forbidden.description: AUTH_TOKEN_SCOPE: the token lacks the scope this operation names.

QuotaExhausted.description: The request would pass a quota's limit. The error code is the quota's name in upper case, prefixed QUOTA_. Nothing was stored.

TagSet.description: The tag set, by reference. Rows carry it in their Tags column.

FocusRow.description: The row, by reference. One record of an export body.

BatchId.description: Chosen by the sender and unique within the tenant. A retry of one batch reuses its id. From GitHub Actions it is repository_id, run_id and run_attempt joined by hyphens, so a retry of one run's send restates its batch and a re-run attempt adds a batch.

InstallationId.description: The kind, a colon and the SCM's numeric id. github is a GitHub App installation. github-owner is the repository_owner_id of an account that runs only the Action. gitlab-namespace is a GitLab.com namespace_id. A name is never an id.

NumericId.description: An SCM's id for an owner, repository or project. Both SCMs state it as a string of digits.

ProofAudience.description: The tenant the proof is for, as https://app.costroid.com/tenants/ and the tenant id. It must equal the audience of the tenant behind the bearer. One string, never a list.

RunAudience.description: The audience of a run token: https://app.costroid.com/tenants/, the tenant id, then /rows. It must equal the rows audience of the tenant behind the bearer. One string, never a list. A proof's audience never matches it, and it never matches a proof's.

RunTokenClaims.description: The decoded payload of a run token from GitHub Actions. Other claims are ignored and not stored. repository is the name GitHub signed for this run, and the rows' costroid/repo is checked against it. An export does not read sha, because no source shows that it names the pull request's head on a pull_request run. PUT /merges/{merge_id} reads sha, ref and ref_type too, under MergeRunTokenClaims.

ProofHeader.description: The decoded JOSE header of a proof. One algorithm, so a verifier has one path.

GitHubCiClaims.description: The decoded payload of a CI proof from GitHub Actions. Other claims are ignored and not stored. repository_owner and repository are names, and they prove nothing.

event_name.description: A schedule runs only on the default branch. A push counts only on a protected ref. Every other event is refused.

ref_protected.description: Read only for a push. Assumed to be a string, like every other GitHub claim: no real token has been read.

GitLabCiClaims.description: The decoded payload of a CI proof from GitLab.com. Other claims are ignored and not stored. namespace_path and project_path are names, and they prove nothing.

AttestationClaims.description: The decoded payload of an App attestation, signed by Costroid's hosted service.

owner_id.description: The id of the account the App is installed on.

delivery.description: The id of the signed GitHub delivery behind this attestation.

InstallationBinding.description: The body of PUT /installations/{installation_id}. The proof's signed claims name the installation and the tenant. The proof is never stored and never logged.

InstallationStatus.description: active: this tenant holds the owner. revoked: the binding was given up, or the App was uninstalled or suspended. displaced: a stated rule gave the owner to another tenant.

Tenant.description: An organization. Costroid and Costroid Platform share it.

Account.description: The person who issued the token, by id. No address leaves through this contract.

Token.description: A token's metadata. Never the secret.

Installation.description: One binding. An ended binding stays listed, because the tenant's rows still name it.

owner_id.description: The SCM's id for the owner. One owner belongs to one tenant at a time, across every kind of id.

proven_at.description: The issue time of the newest proof accepted for this binding.

ended_at.description: Null while the binding is active.

code.description: Stable. README.md, section The export endpoint, lists the codes. A client treats a code it does not know as a failed batch.

rows.description: Null until the batch has ingested.

dropped_tag_keys.description: How many Tags entries outside costroid/ were dropped before storage, across the batch's rows. Null until the batch has ingested. Names and values are never kept.

QuotaName.description: exports_per_day counts the batches accepted for ingest in a UTC day, restatements included. A repeat of bytes already held is not counted. export_bytes_per_day sums the bodies of those batches in bytes. max_batch_bytes bounds one body in bytes and has no window. reconciliations_per_day counts the PUT /reconciliations bodies stored in a UTC day. max_reconciliation_lines bounds the lines of one such body, max_reconciliation_bytes its size in bytes and max_reconciliation_line_bytes one line in bytes. max_reconciliation_range_days bounds the days one GET /reconciliations spans. The four max_reconciliation_ limits have no window. reconciliations_per_day, max_reconciliation_lines, max_reconciliation_bytes and max_reconciliation_line_bytes can only rise.

QuotaState.description: ok, approaching at 80% of the limit, or exhausted.

limit.description: Null means no limit applies to this tenant.

window_resets_at.description: Null for a limit with no window.

Error.description: Every refusal. The code is the contract, the message is for people.

ExportRefusalCode.description: Every synchronous refusal of PUT /exports/{batch_id} that is not about the bearer or a quota. Each stores nothing.

ExportRefusal.description: A refused export. Nothing was stored.

InstallationRefusal.description: Every refusal of a proof or a binding.

BindingHolder.description: The binding of this owner that the platform holds when the request arrives.

changed_at.description: proven_at for an active binding, ended_at for one that ended.

BindingCase.description: A test vector, never a wire shape: what one PUT /installations/{installation_id} sees once its proof has decoded, and what it must answer. It assumes a proof whose signature verifies. An implementation runs these files.

MergeId.description: Chosen by the sender and unique within the tenant. From GitHub Actions it is repository_id and the pull request's number joined by a hyphen, in the form a batch id has.

Repo.description: The repository: host and path, no scheme, as tags/v0.4 writes costroid/repo.

CommitSha.description: 40 hexadecimal characters for SHA-1, 64 for SHA-256, lower case.

PullRequestNumber.description: The pull request's number, the number costroid/pr carries, as a JSON integer.

MergeDocument.description: The body of PUT /merges/{merge_id}: this pull request of this repository merged at this instant as this commit. No other key is read in this version, and an unknown key refuses the body.

merged_at.description: The instant the pull request merged, in UTC, to the second.

merge_commit_sha.description: The commit the merge put on the base branch.

RunIdentity.description: token_verified: a run token verified, its sha is merge_commit_sha and its ref_type is branch. unverified: any other request.

MergeFact.description: A stored merge fact: the document as stored, its id and its grade.

MergeRunTokenClaims.description: The decoded payload of a run token on PUT /merges/{merge_id}: the claims of RunTokenClaims, and three more the platform reads on this path. A token whose sha is not merge_commit_sha, or whose ref_type is not branch, or that lacks either, stores the fact as unverified.

sha.description: The commit the run is for.

ref.description: The ref the run is for.

MergeRefusalCode.description: Every refusal of PUT /merges/{merge_id} that is not about the bearer. Each stores nothing.

MergeRefusal.description: A refused merge fact. Nothing was stored.

Decimal.description: An amount: an optional leading minus, digits, and an optional point followed by 1 to 30 digits, at most 64 characters in all. No exponent and no leading plus. Never a JSON number. A provider's figure is carried as the provider states it, and a derived figure inherits its scale.

NonNegativeDecimal.description: An amount that is never negative: digits, and an optional point followed by 1 to 30 digits, at most 64 characters in all. No exponent and no sign. Never a JSON number.

TokenCount.description: A whole number of tokens: digits only, at most 20. Never a JSON number.

TokenDelta.description: A difference of two token counts: an optional leading minus and digits only, at most 20 digits.

ReconciliationSource.description: The provider whose report the row was compared with, as the sender names it: anthropic or openai from Costroid.

Credential.description: The rows' SubAccountId: the key, workspace, project or service account the rows spent on.

ReconciliationState.description: The verdict on tokens and prices. matched: every class landed within 1% and every price matched. tokens_miss: a class missed 1%, a defect. price_miss: every class matched and a price missed the catalog, a defect. pending: the provider has not finished reporting the day, or a run on the credential crossed midnight UTC into a day outside the compared range or not yet reported. The list is closed.

DollarVerdict.description: within: list-price dollars landed within 10% of the cost report for the day. outside: they did not. no_bill: every ledger row is list-equivalent, so no bill exists to compare with. The list is closed.

CauseName.description: A named cause of a dollar residual. shared_key: traffic on the credential the rows never saw. tier: a service tier's premium. residency: a region's premium. contract_rate: the billed figure against the list figure. run_spans_days: tokens a run moved across midnight UTC. The list is closed.

ComparedClass.description: A token class as a comparison names it. cache_write is the cache writes of every lifetime, compared as one figure where the rows cannot see a write's lifetime.

TokenCheck.description: One token class compared. delta is provider minus ledger. within holds when delta is at most 1% of provider, inclusive.

PriceCheck.description: One price proved: the cost report's list figure for one model's class on the day, over the usage report's tokens for the same model and class. Amounts are in the row's currency, and unit prices are per million tokens. match holds when tokens at catalog_unit_price land within one unit of the last digit the report states.

class.description: Prices are proved per lifetime, so cache_write does not appear here.

implied_unit_price.description: provider_list over tokens, per million tokens, rounded to six places. Null when tokens is zero. No verdict reads it.

ClassDollars.description: One token class at list price on both sides. delta is provider minus ledger. within holds when delta is at most 1% of provider, inclusive.

Cause.description: The part of a residual one named cause accounts for.

RoundingCheck.description: FOCUS 1.4's rounding variance tolerance applied to provider_list against the ledger's list cost. currency equals the row's currency. variance is provider_list minus ledger. within holds when the variance is inside MAX(100 × Subunit, SQRT(rows) × 0.5 × Subunit), inclusive.

rows.description: The number of ledger rows summed.

DollarCheck.description: List-price ledger cost against the cost report: for the day, or on a span's first day for every day of the span together. residual is provider minus ledger, and it equals the sum of causes and unattributed. Every amount is in the row's currency.

classes.description: Each class at list price. Null when the report does not split token cost by class, and on a no_bill day.

ledger.description: The ledger's list cost for the day.

provider.description: What the report bills for tokens. Equal to provider_effective.

provider_effective.description: What the report bills for tokens, after any discount.

provider_list.description: The same charges at list price. Null when the report does not state a list figure on every token line.

other_cost.description: What the report bills for anything but tokens, which the comparison leaves out.

rounding.description: Null when provider_list is null, and on a no_bill day.

Span.description: The days a run crossed midnight UTC over, compared as one because a day of them missed on its own and together they matched. They are compared as one for dollars as for tokens. The row of from holds the joined token comparison and the joined dollar comparison. Each later day's row carries the span and the span's state, with tokens and dollars null, and reads by the row of from.

ReconciliationRow.description: One reconciliation of one credential on one UTC day, as costroid reconcile --out writes it, with currency. source, credential and day are its key. Every amount is a decimal string. A pending row carries no figure, and a later day of a span carries no tokens or dollars of its own.

final.description: False while the provider can still restate the day: through the eighth day after the day's month ends.

data_refreshed_at.description: The provider's freshness stamp on the reports that carried the day, the earliest when several did. Null when the provider stamps none.

currency.description: The currency of every amount in the row, prices included. Where dollars.rounding is present, its currency equals this one.

tokens.description: One check per class either side holds. Null on a pending row, on a later day of a span, and on a day neither side holds tokens.

prices.description: One check per model, tier, region and class the report proves a price for. Null on a pending row.

dollars.description: Null when the row holds no dollar comparison: on a pending row, and on a later day of a span.

allOf.description: A pending row carries no figure.
A row with a span is its first day, with the joined tokens and dollars, or a later day, with neither.

ReconciliationReceipt.description: What a stored body did, line by line. stored: the row is new, or replaced the stored row of its key. unchanged: the stored row of its key is equal to it. ignored: the stored row is final and this one is not, or this row's data_refreshed_at is earlier than the stored row's.

RunReference.description: The run a verified run token named.

StoredReconciliation.description: A stored row with who sent it and when. The row is the sender's statement, never the platform's measurement.

token_id.description: The integration token that sent the row.

run.description: Null when the body came without a run token.

ReconciliationList.description: The answer of GET /reconciliations, in order of day.

ReconciliationRefusalCode.description: Every refusal of PUT /reconciliations that is not about the bearer or a quota. Each stores nothing.

ReconciliationRefusal.description: A refused body. Nothing was stored. RECONCILIATION_INVALID names the first line that is not a row of this version in line, counted from 1. No other code carries line.
